what_it_is: Autre is a large-format Los Angeles magazine covering art, fashion and culture through long interviews, essays and photography, with each issue organised around a single theme (Issue 23 is 'Wellness', Issue 22 'Surveillance'). Issues run several hundred pages, come with four alternative celebrity or artist covers, and every print order includes a digital edition. It is aimed at readers of contemporary art and culture criticism who want a theme-driven, collectible print object twice a year.
